description:
## Request from Denson: make the live research presentation work on a laptop alone
During a live voice presentation on the laptop, with the external monitor disconnected, Denson could not see all the treatment choices together. Reducing Chrome zoom to 75% made the text hard to read. The tour is PAUSED at the treatment landscape; retain that place and do not restart it.

This ticket is the requested handoff to the original website/source agent. Implement and verify the change; this laptop agent is not publishing a layout change as part of filing this ticket. Related handoff: fieldwork-s39. Original delivery: fieldwork-m89.

## Requested result
Create a compact, laptop-friendly treatment overview that lets the audience see the complete set of choices at readable browser zoom before the presenter asks which treatment to explore.

Show all six landscape approaches together, each with its existing icon, readable name, and a short plain-language description:
- Tacrolimus ointment
- Implantable lymphatic pump
- BioBridge collagen matrix
- Lymfactin / VEGF-C
- Lymphovenous bypass
- Lymph node transfer
Keep the separate acebilustat focus clearly available as the main tour's next option. Do not accidentally drop it or present six approaches as an evidence-based ranking.

Use a compact overview with selectable details: selecting a treatment should reveal or navigate to its existing detailed explanation and sources. Move large artwork and long descriptions out of the initial choice overview if needed. Preserve the full research content, illustrations/provenance, treatment/reference icon associations, shared-source associations, and evidence caveats. Keep readable text, keyboard access, clear controls, and responsive behavior; do not solve the problem by shrinking all text or requiring 75% zoom.

## Presenter change explicitly requested by Denson
At the treatment landscape, after the overview is visible, the presenter SHOULD ask: "Would you like to take a closer look at any particular treatment?" Then stop and wait for the answer. This is an explicit exception to the earlier general rule against unsolicited question/continuation prompts. The problem with asking before the layout fix was that the audience could not see all the choices. Do not add prompts to other sections. Retain the one-short-section-at-a-time pacing and place across interruptions.

Update the applicable presentation route/narration and agent handoff instructions to reflect this narrow exception, synchronizing canonical/root/dist script copies and the presenter reader where affected. Preserve the research-watch narration override and the verified-Gmail requirement on the closing email offer.

## Source and publication
Private source: https://github.com/denson/lymphedema-research (current main; read AGENTS.md and LAPTOP-HANDOFF.md).
Live Site: https://acebilustat-lymphedema-research.denson.chatgpt.site/
Landscape URL: https://acebilustat-lymphedema-research.denson.chatgpt.site/?section=landscape
Existing Site ID: appgprj_6ad2c698b9a48191a411fa4f3e6b277d.
Use the installed Sites skill to reconcile/edit the existing bound source and publish to the same Site with the existing owner-private audience, then synchronize portable source to the private repository. A GitHub push alone does not redeploy the Site. Do not create a replacement Site, localhost preview, duplicate monitor, or modify Boodlebot knowledge merely to change layout. Keep local files outside OneDrive.

## Acceptance checks
1. In real desktop Chrome at 100% zoom, check representative laptop viewports such as 1366x768 and 1536x864. The treatment overview shows all six readable names and brief descriptions together below the navigation, with an obvious path to acebilustat. Record actual viewport/zoom evidence; do not claim the physical laptop display was verified from an emulation alone.
2. Selecting each approach reaches its correct details and original sources; returning to the overview retains a clear tour position. Keyboard navigation works. Narrower/mobile layouts remain readable without horizontal overflow.
3. Named section URLs, section selector, Previous/Next, direct-link positioning below sticky headers, and #presentation-status/#presentation-state still work. Preserve target/heading visibility checks and optional-topic return routing.
4. Research limitations and all existing source/icon mappings remain accurate and intact. No new medical claims or research refresh are needed for this layout task.
5. Publish through Sites, verify the deployed landscape and a treatment-detail round trip in desktop Chrome, push synchronized source, and leave a Beadwork receipt with source commit, deployed URL, checks, screenshots, and any remaining limits. Hand back to the laptop agent for a final physical-screen readability check with Denson before resuming narration.

# fieldwork-v3b — laptop treatment overview delivery

Implemented and published to the existing owner-private Site.

- Live overview: https://acebilustat-lymphedema-research.denson.chatgpt.site/?section=landscape
- Published source commit: 03c575a699ff95e5d5118ee66f8d21901794b6a7
- Deployment: appgdep_6ad5b2e279d88191b28965303aa7e91d — succeeded.
- Saved version: appgprj_6ad2c698b9a48191a411fa4f3e6b277d~appgver_0a01d98833cc81919996113a2d8dcf61
- Portable source: https://github.com/denson/lymphedema-research

The overview shows all six approaches as a three-column, two-row grid at laptop widths. Each choice retains its icon and has a readable name and 16-pixel description. A separate acebilustat option and comparison caveat remain visible. Full explanations, original source links, eight illustrations, provenance and shared reference icons remain intact below the overview. Six detail-return links preserve tour position; lymph node transfer now also has its own named optional route.

Narration, root/dist plan and text copies, presenter reader, route map and handoff instructions include exactly one requested prompt at the visible landscape: “Would you like to take a closer look at any particular treatment?” Then stop. Other sections retain the no-prompts rule. The research-watch override and verified-Gmail requirement remain. The laptop tour is recorded as PAUSED at landscape, superseding the historical completed desktop tour.

## Verification
Source checks preserved every original research paragraph, bibliography and treatment/image mapping. Script formats and route anchors match; JavaScript syntax and Git whitespace checks passed. No medical claims were refreshed.

Live desktop Chrome checks used explicit viewport overrides after Ctrl+0 reset to 100% zoom. Observed devicePixelRatio=1, visualViewport.scale=1 and body CSS zoom=1.
- 1366×768: all six choices, acebilustat option and caveat visible; overview bottom about 626px; description text 16px; no horizontal overflow.
- 1536×864: same result, overview bottom about 626px.
- 390×844: single-column layout, readable 16px descriptions, scrolling expected, no horizontal overflow.
- All six choice/detail/overview round trips passed, with correct headings visible below sticky navigation, correct source IDs, and optional previous=landscape / next=acebilustat.
- Keyboard Enter opened a choice, Tab reached its first citation, and Enter on the return link restored overview focus.
- R11 retained both surgery icons and its original DOI link. Browser Back restored the selected node-transfer detail.
- Reload, section selector, optional Previous, Next and the visible/JSON presentation state passed after navigation completed.

Machine-readable evidence: verification/fieldwork-v3b-browser.json.
Screenshots attached to fieldwork-v3b in the Fieldwork Beadwork ledger:
- preview-laptop-overview-1366.png
- preview-laptop-overview-1536.png
- preview-laptop-overview-390.png
- preview-laptop-treatment-detail.png

## Handoff / remaining limit
These were desktop Chrome viewport tests, not a test on Denson's physical laptop display. The laptop agent should pull current main and confirm readability with Denson at 100% on that display before resuming the paused landscape. WebMCP was unavailable in this desktop connection; direct URLs and visible navigation were verified. Temporary viewport overrides were reset. No localhost preview, new Site, sharing change, monitor change, Boodlebot update or email was needed.

Related laptop takeover: fieldwork-s39. The website implementation is complete; the physical-screen confirmation belongs to the laptop takeover.
